$comment: Where the paper lives and which manifest version the site is built from. Paths are relative to this file. Bump 'manifest' and 'downloads' when a new version of the paper is built.

site.name: The Capacity Planning Practice
site.$indexable: false keeps search engines out (robots.txt, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag). Set true when you want the site found by search. Sharing the link works either way.

community.$comment: Where the community lives. 'open' is false during the private preview: the links are shown but marked as opening at launch. Set it to true when the repository is public. 'linkedinPage' is the practice's LinkedIn Page (live now); 'linkedin' is the discussion group, once it opens.
community.editionNote: built from the working paper, version 7.6

elsewhere.$comment: Linkage to the rest of the environment. Empty values are skipped. CPP links to anacay.org, never to anacay.com (Governance); anacay.org links onward.
